verdict.rationale: Graphite documents one clear background automation: once enabled, Graphite Agent automatically reviews every new pull request in the selected repositories, following configurable custom rules and exclusions. The stack-aware merge queue also lands PRs in order without manual steps. The pricing page lists an "Automations" feature, but the evidence never says what it does or what triggers and actions users can configure, and Agents are user-initiated rather than background. missing for 10: documentation of the general Automations feature (configurable triggers and actions), autonomously triggered agent tasks beyond PR review, independent or hands-on corroboration.
